caption: The drawing depicts a single object that appears to be a semicircular piece of delicate lace or embroidered fabric, possibly a collar or yoke. It is rendered in shades of gray on a light or off-white background, making the entire composition monochromatic. The main object is shown flat and spread out, occupying the center of the image with its curved edge facing downward and the shorter, straight edges at the top. The fabric features intricate patterns of floral and botanical motifs, with small leaves and circular flower-like shapes densely arranged along the surface. The lace or netting texture is clearly visible, and the detailing suggests fine needlework. The negative space inside the curve and around the object is left empty, highlighting the detailed design of the central object.
title: Embroidered Linen Collar
